meta.name: brand-semantic-tokens
meta.description: Shared semantic slots that every BRAND theme resolves.

color.surface.canvas: Theme background for the page or app shell.
color.surface.app: Primary shell surface when a product uses layered backgrounds.
color.surface.panel: Default card, panel, or sheet surface.
color.surface.elevated: Raised surface for nested cards, drawers, and overlays.
color.accent.primary: Primary brand accent used for highlights and key moments.
color.accent.secondary: Supporting accent for hover, glow, or gradient anchors.
color.accent.soft: Tinted accent background for subtle emphasis.
color.effect.glass.fill: Glassmorphism fill when a theme supports it.
color.effect.glass.border: Glassmorphism border when a theme supports it.

type.font.body: Body and UI family for the theme.
type.font.mono: Monospace family for code and token display.
type.size.title: Section or card title size.
type.size.label: Eyebrow, tag, and label size.
type.tracking.label: Label and UI tracking.
type.case.label: Label casing rule.

shadow.emphasis: Special glow or hover emphasis shadow.

document.surface.sheetAlt: Alternate document surface for chips, tables, and summary cards.
document.accent.strong: Document darker accent or gradient anchor.
document.layout.pageInset: Document page inset or shell padding.
